response.sql: SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions WHERE invoice_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type <> 'Payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with a NULL invoice_number are excluded before grouping, as the request specifies.
'Payment' is matched exactly and case-sensitively, with no trimming, so 'payment' or 'Payment ' counts as a non-Payment type.

The count includes all transactions for each qualifying invoice, including its 'Payment' rows, because the request asks for the total recorded. An invoice qualifies if it has at least one non-'Payment' transaction.
Invoices with equal transaction counts have no defined order at the top-10 cutoff, since the request gives no tiebreaker.
